jobs.description: Are you excited about the incredible opportunity that cloud computing represents? Are you passionate about delivering high-quality services and ready to apply your experience at massive scale? Amazon Web Services' Cloud Storage, Amazon S3, is one of the largest distributed storage systems in the world. We host trillions of objects and serve hundreds of millions of requests per second and we're continuing to grow! We are looking for a passionate Software Development Manager to lead a team responsible for the S3 Index's request routing systems. The S3 Index maintains the metadata for the objects stored in S3. We tackle some of the hardest computer science problems. We build systems that can handle wildly varying access patterns and unprecedented load by our customers. As the leader of this team, you will be tackling complex challenges in supporting new features, performance optimization, and system decoupling, ensuring that S3 continues to deliver exceptional reliability and performance at massive scale. In this role, you will: - Lead a team of talented software engineers, fostering their growth and development while delivering critical components of S3's architecture - Drive the technical roadmap for S3 Index's request routing - Invent new ways to ensure correctness and optimize performance data flows through the S3 object Request Plane - Enable end-to-end data integrity and performance optimizations across S3 Request Plane, Index, and Storage systems - Protect against coupling between systems in accessing S3 objects to meet organizational needs - Ensure operational excellence through metrics, monitoring, and continuous improvement You'll partner with senior leaders and peer teams across S3 including Index, Object APIs, and Storage to set direction, align priorities, and continuously improve our systems and deliver exceptional customer experiences. A successful candidate will feel strongly not only about building good software but about building great teams. The ideal candidate will be able to lead in resource-constrained and performance-sensitive areas, with relentlessly high standards. This role is technical: you'll be expected to contribute to architecture discussions while regularly taking part in deep-dive troubleshooting exercises or technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues. A strong understanding of distributed systems and experience operating services at scale is a plus. AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. About the team About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7!
About the Role
DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations. In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.
Help improve operations: Contribute ideas to improve our quality and customer experience.
We’re excited about you because…
You’re self-motivated, positive, and a team player. You work well with others, and you bring a great attitude to your work each and every day. You have high integrity and are excited to delight customers.
You have a proven track record of success in food and beverage, warehouse, and/or retail environments.
You’re able to be on your feet and move heavy products. You are excited and physically able (with or without accommodation) to lift up to 50 lbs., depending on the needs of the specific site, and can operate a pallet jack and hand truck.

You have a high school diploma or GED equivalent. A college diploma is even better but not required.

■業務内容
上記の組織におけるソフトウェア開発、または開発リーディングを担当していただきます。
担当する技術領域や役割については、スキル、ご経験、ご希望を踏まえて決定します。

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. We are looking for a Threat Intelligence Engineer to join our Threat Intelligence team. In this role, you will build the infrastructure that powers our threat discovery capabilities—integrating external data sources, developing detection systems for automated lead generation, and creating internal tooling that scales our investigators' impact.
This is a foundational engineering role on a small, high-impact team. You will take projects from proof-of-concept to production, work closely with investigators to understand their needs, and help scale what may become a multi-person collections function.

jobs.description: Serverless technologies are dramatically changing the business landscape for AWS customers large and small. AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event-driven apps, and AI agents. We're looking for experienced engineers to help lead our global-scale Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. A successful team member will exhibit creativity, empathy, and optimism as we push the boundaries of serverless computing in the cloud. We are inspired by what has come before and motivated to create what comes next. You'll thrive in this role if you are interested in large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems, low latency request processing, and p100 anomalies. You are capable in one or more programming languages and open to learning new ones. You include customer experience when discussing engineering alternatives and value creating APIs that make "the right thing, the easy thing." You value operational sustainability and advocate for eliminating flaky tests as soon as possible. You also think having fun goes together with tackling hard problems like supercomputing, high availability, and building loosely coupled gRPC-based microservices, all while continuing to securely and reliably handle massive traffic with millisecond latency. Key job responsibilities - Lead the architecture and design of large-scale, highly available, low-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions - Set technical direction across teams, balancing near-term delivery with long-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap - Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations - Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience - Help define and deliver new serverless compute experiences for web, event-driven, and instance-based workloads - Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the organization - Lead operational excellence: set standards for observability, deployment safety, and incident response, and drive lasting fixes - Work with product managers, engineering leaders, and partner AWS teams to deliver results for customers A day in the life You might start the day leading a design review for a new scaling mechanism, spend the afternoon digging into a tail-latency problem across the invoke path, and wrap up mentoring an engineer through their first major design document. You'll work directly with customer feedback and production metrics, and your decisions will shape how Lambda evolves over the next several years. About the team AWS Lambda is part of AWS Serverless Compute. The Lambda data plane teams own the core invoke path, the worker fleet and virtualization layer, scaling and placement, event processing, and new compute models such as Lambda Managed Instances. We value ownership, operational excellence, and simplicity, and we invest in growing engineers at every level.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking research scientists with deep medicinal chemistry expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert medicinal chemist with hands-on experience designing, synthesizing, purifying, and characterizing small molecules. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll drive experimental programs end to end and pressure-test AI-designed molecules and AI-proposed synthetic routes against real chemistry.
This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Key responsibilities
Design multi-step synthetic routes for small molecules and oversee their execution end to end, including route selection, reaction optimization, purification strategy, and interpretation of full characterization data (NMR, LC-MS, HPLC)
Coordinate synthesis and biological evaluation with external contract research organizations and academic partners
Evaluate AI-designed molecules and AI-proposed synthetic routes, drive them to experimental readout, and feed results back to research teams
Apply medicinal chemistry principles, including SAR analysis and physicochemical property optimization, to compound design and prioritization
Ensure experimental data across programs is high quality and well documented, including procedures, spectra, and failure modes
Communicate findings clearly to chemistry, AI research, and life sciences audiences
Minimum qualifications
PhD in chemistry
Demonstrated medicinal chemistry experience, including SAR-driven design and optimization of small molecules, with recent, sustained hands-on synthetic work
Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills
Preferred qualifications
5+ years of medicinal chemistry experience beyond the PhD
Track record of advancing programs from hit identification through lead optimization
Experience directing synthetic chemistry activities at contract research organizations
Computational chemistry, cheminformatics, or coding skills, for example Python with RDKit or pandas for data analysis and automation
Experience using AI or ML tools in the life sciences
Publications and/or patents demonstrating scientific impact

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!

About the Team
DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash’s leading SaaS business unit, offering a suite of products across online ordering, branded websites and mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable restaurants to reach customers and grow their revenue through their own first-party channels.
The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.
Strategy & Operations sits at the center of that opportunity. The team partners with Product to set the strategy and vision for every offering in the suite, across our SMB and enterprise merchants. We decide what to build, where to invest, and how to bring it to market, and we learn by putting products in front of merchants and running the experiments that show us what moves their business.
As part of this team, the Associate will take end-to-end ownership of one or more product initiatives and lead the cross-functional execution that brings them to life. Your work will be instrumental to helping grow Digital Ordering into an industry-leading B2B SaaS offering.
About the Role
As an Associate on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will own one or more product initiatives within our first-party suite from end to end. You will develop the strategy, define key results, and drive execution in partnership with S&O, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, and Marketing. This role is ideal for a strategic operator who can move fast and wear many hats, equal parts analyst, builder, operator, and cross-functional leader.
You will own zero-to-one experiments and initiatives that improve products already operating at scale, help shape the roadmap with Product, and work directly with merchants and frontline teams to identify the gaps worth solving. Scope on this team grows with demonstrated ownership, and the people who do well here identify problems independently and come back with a plan to solve them.
You will join the Foundational Products team, the products that are table stakes for every restaurant we serve and that drive the core of our revenue today across SMB and Enterprise. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Strategy & Operations, Foundational Products.
We’re especially excited about candidates who’ve worked in fast-moving, founder-led, or resource-constrained environments, those who see lack of structure as an opportunity to build.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own product initiatives from end to end and be accountable for their results
Imagine, develop, and execute on workstreams from start to completion with little oversight
Oscillate easily from strategic considerations to tactical execution
Build deep and meaningful relationships with merchants, laser focused on helping them thrive
Have the opportunity to truly make a scalable, measurable impact on the restaurant industry in the US and abroad
Operate comfortably in ambiguous environments while maintaining a strong bias for action
Grow your scope as you demonstrate ownership and impact
Communicate precisely dependent on audience and level of detail necessary to share
Represent the DoorDash brand with humility and a customer-first mindset
Your responsibilities will include:
Own product initiatives:
Take end-to-end ownership of one or more product initiatives. Develop the strategy, define goals and key results, and build the business case, financial model, and go-to-market plan. Drive execution from launch into growth, with accountability for the results.
Lead cross-functionally:
Bring Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, Marketing, and Support behind a plan and hold partners accountable to it without formal authority. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a launch on schedule and the feedback loop that informs what gets built next.
Analyze:
Pair complex data analysis with qualitative insight from merchants and frontline teams to guide strategic decisions. Build your own models, assess weekly performance against key results, and translate findings into action plans, adjusting course as needed.
Experiment:
Design and launch zero-to-one tests, build AI tools and automations to support internal processes and product launches, and pilot tools, demos, or prototype agents. Move quickly to retire what does not work and scale what does. You will work directly with merchants, including occasional travel to stores and running in-market tests as needed.
Represent the merchant:
Act as the voice of the merchant and the field, leading discovery interviews and synthesizing feedback from Sales, Implementation, Support, and merchants themselves to help influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities. You will ensure our products resonate with restaurants and scale with repeatable excellence.
Scale learnings:
Codify what works. Build the repeatable frameworks, processes, and enablement that raise the bar across the org, and define best practices for launching new products in a way that’s scalable and measurable.
The best candidates will:
Think like a founder, identifying the problems nobody flagged, building the case for solving them, and driving them to resolution with limited structure or direction
Bring strong analytical horsepower and intellectual curiosity, comfortable diving into complex data and extracting insights that drive real-world decisions
Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, moving with urgency, defaulting to action, taking ownership end to end, and knowing when to bend process to get things done
Lead cross-functional teams through influence, building trust with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing partners and holding them to their commitments
Communicate clearly across audiences, presenting findings and defending recommendations with data
Have experience working closely with Sales or frontline teams, and know how to turn insights from those teams into action
Bring hands-on experience using AI, automation, or internal tooling to improve workflows or prototype solutions
We’re excited about you because you…
Have 2-3 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, product, or founder-type roles
Have taken a product or initiative from inception through launch and into growth, leading cross-functional partners without a fully defined brief
Demonstrate the judgment to identify gaps worth solving and shape product priorities alongside S&O and Product partners
Can independently devise and execute a strategy to achieve business outcomes
Bring a strong analytical background, with the ability to synthesize large data sets into meaningful insights (proficiency in SQL preferred)
Lead cross-functionally and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing
Define goals and key results for your initiatives, and hold yourself accountable for achieving them
Bring exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain insights, defend recommendations, and tailor messaging across frontline teams, senior leaders, and merchants
Have piloted or built with AI tools in real-world workflows, such as automating processes, prototyping solutions, or supporting product launches
Bring a founder mindset, identifying problems independently and driving them to resolution
Bachelor's degree required.
Bonus if you have experience with:
Founding or operating your own company or product, or an early employee role at a startup
Building and executing go-to-market motions
Working in a high-growth environment
Client or account management
Building financial or sales forecasting models
Restaurant, SaaS, or marketplace businesses
Both zero-to-one work in a lean environment and scaling products at a larger organization
Are the first in your family to attend college
Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash
We are leaders:
Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies
We are operators:
We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day
We are learners:
Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers
We are one team:
The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.
